contexts.text: (Thus) with an insincere and unjust man, the internal man has been formed into an image of Hell, and the external man into an image of a Heaven which is subordinated to Hell...
When anything presents itself which the man knows to be insincere and unjust...
Hence, in the Word... what is unjust is said of that to which are ascribed self-righteousness and self-merit.
When he sees that injustice triumphs over justice...
God hath remembered her injustices () = that the Lord will protect the Heavens from violence therefrom. ( = that falsities from evils have separated them from the Lord. AE 1112.)

He that is unjust, let him be unjust still () = that goods will be taken away from those who are in evils... The unjust = him who is in evils... Thus let the unjust be unjust still = that he who is in evils will be still more in evils; (which implies) that goods have been taken away from him.
Why does He permit the injustice and impiety of the devil to triumph...
(This would be) to accuse the Lord Himself... of injustice.
The greatest justice would be injustice. Explained.
He sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust () = that the Lord inflows... with Divine truth equally with those outside the Jewish Church and with those within it.
